subtitle: Atelier's own releases.
description: Releases of Atelier, the on-device app signer. Add this source to get Atelier updates.

apps.name: Atelier
apps.subtitle: Sign and install apps on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Atelier downloads, signs and installs apps from AltStore-compatible sources with your own certificate, all on the device.

versions.localizedDescription: Atelier now installs from the iPhone alone, with no computer: on iOS 27, its website installs it with your Apple ID, free or paid, through a Shortcut and rootshell, a free app, and Atelier opens signed in, on its welcome and then Get Ready with your Apple ID already in. The Library is easier to tap and to use with VoiceOver, its status colours are easier to read in light mode, and its filter says whose apps it shows. On an iPad, Atelier says this iPad.

Atelier installed with a free Apple ID now renews and updates itself with that Apple ID, and after the iPhone-only installer it opens already signed in, reusing the installer's certificate. Atelier no longer keeps your Apple ID's password, only Apple's sign-in token, and asks you to Sign In Again once that ends. Apps signed with a certificate that comes with App Groups keep theirs, and the website can install Atelier with your certificate from a computer.

Atelier is now open source, at github.com/atelierstore/Atelier, and its updates, website and install server moved to atelierstore.app. Apps signed with an Apple ID keep their App Groups, so a widget or extension shares its app's data again.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Atelier uses the camera to scan QR codes for sources.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Atelier pairs with this iPhone over the local network, and installs apps through that pairing.
